limitations: Only operations named by passed checked-in native records are admitted; failed or merely generated catalogue entries remain visible as unqualified.
Captured PNG texture/image reader slots are explicit; unresolved external reader families and authored execution overrides remain refused.
OBJ TextureFileName can carry an auxiliary texture reference; that option is refused until its file-access semantics have a qualified closed contract.
Axes, definitions, dimensions, views and settings metadata sections are refused in this literal graph profile; qualification of their expansion and indirect file closure is separate.

XML rectilinear-grid, structured-grid and table readers accept only one-piece self-contained inline ASCII numeric captures under the pinned byte grammar; external references, companion files and binary/appended encodings are refused before native parsing.
GenericIOMultiBlockReader is qualified only as managed writer readback. Authored reader nodes and caller-supplied readback filenames are refused; the writer supplies its own declared output path.
schemaxis/1.scope: Serial operations selected from passed native fixture/writer records, with the canonical graph and scene schemas; generated discovery is not native qualification.

schemaxis.sympy/1.scope: Every declared exact rational real-root isolation operation; literal data only.
